P361 (part of) — 382 items with duplicates

The ordinals and the after / before qualifiers are already resolved on the Shikinaisha list entry items; they are not resolved here. Where one Ronsha item absorbed several list entries, their statements collapsed together and the neighbours cross-contaminated — 55 of these carry a statement with more than one P155/P156 value (shaded red, sorted to the top). Those are what the migration has to rebuild from the entry items.
